business_summary: Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmentally related products. The company operates through Manufacturing, Engineering, and Trading business segments. The company offers manufacturing businesses, such as ozone concentration meters, ozone application equipment, industrial deodorizers and deodorizing equipment, energy-saving blowers, water treatment related equipment, infectious disease prevention products, aquaculture related products, and ZEB/ZEH related products. It also offers engineering businesses, such as water and sewage treatment facilities, including water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, various pumping stations; related design, construction, and maintenance of machinery and electrical equipment; and cloud-based remote monitoring and control system E-Qias Cloud, water supply facilities, sewerage facilities, storm water drainage pumping station facility, manhole pump facility. In addition, the company is involved in trading business, such as pumps, blowers, air conditioning, building piping restoration work, energy, water supply degassing and ionization devices, steel structure, crusher, and spirion; and purchases and sells air conditioning equipment, cooling and heating equipment, etc. related to air conditioning equipment, water supply and drainage, sanitary equipment, etc., and construction related to the equipment. Further, it provides waste liquid/waste recycling equipment, waste sorting equipment, and waste treatment equipment; medical devices, chemicals, and reagents; contracts and executes civil engineering, building construction, electrical work, plumbing, steel structures, painting, machinery and equipment installation, and other construction work; real estate leasing and management activities; animal feed and organic fertilizers; leasing and rental business; industrial waste disposal business; and temporary staffing business. Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 에바라짓수교(주) 환경 관련 제품을 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 제조, 엔지니어링 및 무역 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 오존 농도 측정기, 오존 응용 장비, 산업용 탈취제 및 탈취 장비, 에너지 절약형 송풍기, 수처리 관련 장비, 전염병 예방 제품, 양식 관련 제품, ZEB/ZEH 관련 제품 등의 제조 사업을 제공합니다. 또한 정수장, 하수 처리장, 각종 펌프장을 포함한 상하수 처리 시설; 기계 및 전기 장비의 관련 설계, 건설 및 유지 관리; 클라우드 기반 원격 감시 및 제어 시스템 이키아스 클라우드, 상수도 시설, 하수 시설, 우수 배수 펌프장 시설, 맨홀 펌프 시설. 또한 회사는 펌프, 송풍기, 공조, 건물 배관 복원 작업, 에너지, 급수 탈기 및 이온화 장치, 철 구조물, 분쇄기, 스피리온 등 무역 사업에 참여하고 있습니다. 에어컨 EQ를 구매 및 판매하고 있습니다.
